[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png]

**KSNJ: MUPL**

**NVQM: PXSO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c380c93d0c8be0147d2b451074b55ca2d0b81aedd96834b522363577731d350.png]

**EMHD: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c51971a5e0281c520c00c9bece890538dbb8fbab08857d4e672db4653628a7de.png]
